ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota, including the $4M daycare with no kids and a misspelled sign.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme in Minnesota, and could lead to further investigations and accountability.
